items.title: Block (XYZ) Opens Cash App Score To Outside Lenders In Credit Push
items.summary: Block (NYSE:XYZ) is opening its Cash App Score to external lenders through a new partnership with Nova Credit. The Cash App Score, built on users' cash flow data, will be accessible to lenders across multiple consumer finance categories. The collaboration uses Nova Credit’s platform to plug Cash App Score into third-party underwriting systems beyond Block’s own products.
